definition: A Business Day is a day on which BOTH the New York Stock Exchange is open AND the U.S. Federal Reserve Banks are open (weekends excluded). Verify these lists each year against the NYSE and Federal Reserve published holiday schedules.

notes.2026-04-03: Good Friday: NYSE closed, Federal Reserve open -> not a Business Day
notes.2026-07-03: Independence Day observed by NYSE; Federal Reserve open (Saturday holiday rule) -> not a Business Day
notes.2026-10-12: Columbus Day: NYSE open, Federal Reserve closed -> not a Business Day
notes.2026-11-11: Veterans Day: NYSE open, Federal Reserve closed -> not a Business Day
